verdict.rationale: Evidence only mentions that graph compilation performs 'basic checks on the structure of your graph (no orphaned nodes, etc.)' — a limited form of build-time validation, not strict typing or schema validation of agent outputs/tool calls. Missing for 10: documentation of typed state schemas (Pydantic/TypedDict) being enforced at compile time, explicit schema validation for node inputs/outputs, and any evidence of it catching agent mistakes before runtime.
